findings.highlight: If she closes in, he throws daggers to prevent her from finishing the fight, and if she doesn't close in, that gives him a chance to retreat.
findings.evidenceJa: 接近されては勝負にならぬと踏んだからこその投擲、接近されまいとするからこその後退だ
findings.governingReading: 接近されては勝負にならぬ explains the throws because he would lose at close range; 接近されまい explains retreat to prevent her approaching.
findings.explanation: Daggers and retreat both meant to prevent closeness become actions under opposite conditions.

findings.highlight: the sinister aura plainly emanating from Assassin.
findings.evidenceJa: アサシンの周囲に不吉な気配を感じる
findings.governingReading: Saber senses something ominous around Assassin, without identifying him as its source. The next page warns against approaching the darkness.
findings.explanation: An ominous presence around Assassin becomes an aura explicitly coming from him. The Japanese leaves its source unspecified, consistent with the next warning about the darkness ahead.

findings.evidenceJa: おまえには見えていたのか
findings.governingReading: おまえには見えていたのか is the question answered by her denial of seeing their actual forms and explanation of reading trajectories.
findings.explanation: Asking whether she saw the daggers becomes asserting she saw them.

findings.governingReading: 誘いこむ筈の獲物 marks his intended draw into the trap, thwarted for now by a ranged weapon.
findings.explanation: Prey he meant to lure in becomes prey he has lured out.

findings.highlight: the vortex of air swallows corridor and skull both
findings.evidenceJa: 廊下と髑髏の面を飲み込もうと
findings.governingReading: 飲み込もうと describes the vortex moving to engulf corridor and mask;27 subsequently explicitly releases the wind.
findings.explanation: The wind winding to swallow its targets becomes already swallowing them.

findings.highlight: It doesn't matter if it's a futile gesture.
findings.evidenceJa: なりふりなど構わない
findings.governingReading: なりふりなど構わない means appearances or decorum no longer matter in the attempt to escape.
findings.explanation: Disregarding appearances becomes disregarding whether escape is futile.

findings.governingReading: それが間違い rejects her one-on-one premise before contrasting her one with their two.
findings.explanation: That was your mistake becomes that is certainly true.

findings.highlight: Her legs becoming both part of this world, and not part of it.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の両足は、既にこの世にあってこの世にないモノになっていた
findings.governingReading: The source says her legs have already become ambiguously of this world and not of it.
findings.explanation: The independent statement about her legs lacks a finite verb.

findings.highlight: All it can do is dumbly strike his opponent.
findings.evidenceJa: 相手を殴りつける事さえできまい
findings.governingReading: 相手を殴りつける事さえできまい is the initial judgment of the apparently nonfunctional folded limb, before it unfolds.
findings.explanation: An arm unable even to strike becomes an arm only able to strike.

findings.highlight: It bends into a grotesque forearm and hand that seems sewn into his shoulder.
findings.evidenceJa: 肘から折り畳まれ、その掌を肩に置いた状態で縫い付けられていた腕
findings.governingReading: 肘から折り畳まれ、その掌を肩に置いた状態 explains why the elbow looked like the arm’s end and the hand was invisible.
findings.explanation: The previously folded-back forearm with its palm sewn at the shoulder loses the folded arrangement.

findings.governingReading: 腰まで伸びた names the attained height as the surrounding narration says it is already becoming her.
findings.explanation: Shadow already extended to the waist becomes reaching for the waist.
